entities.summary: Ryan Edward Gaston Strome is a Canadian ice hockey player who is a centre for the Calgary Flames of the National Hockey League (NHL). He was selected fifth overall in the 2011 NHL entry draft by the New York Islanders and began playing with the team during their 2013–14 season. Previously, Strome played in the major junior level as a member of the Barrie Colts of the Ontario Hockey League (OHL) before being traded to the Niagara IceDogs during his first season in the league. He is the brother of Washington Capitals forward Dylan Strome and current prospect Matthew Strome.
